notes.title: WATCH THE DEVELOPER PLAY
notes.notes:
FIRST FULL VERSION PLAYTHROUGH – CAN WE BEAT THE GAME?!

Hey everyone!

This is a BIG moment—the first time ever playing the full version of I Come In Peace… and guess what? I’ve never beaten it. That’s right, as the developer, I built this game to be brutally hard, and now it’s time to put myself to the test.

I’ll be streaming LIVE with my sister, and we won’t stop playing until one of us finally beats it—or we go completely insane trying. Expect real struggles, epic fails, behind-the-scenes stories, and maybe even a victory (if we're lucky).

📅 Date & Time: February 24, 10:00 AM PST
📍 Where: Right here on our Steam store page!
💬 Jump in the chat, cheer us on, and give us your best tips! We’re gonna need them.

🔥 Will we win? Will we break? Come watch history unfold!

Wishlist the game now & set a reminder—you don’t wanna miss this!

notes.title: New Demo is in the house

notes.title: I Come In Peace is set to be released in March 2025
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings, fellow survivors![/h1]

We are thrilled to share some exciting news about [i]I Come In Peace[/i]. Over the past few months, we've participated in three dedicated playtest events and showcased the game at a three-day gaming festival. Hundreds of unique players experienced the game firsthand and provided invaluable real-time feedback.

Thanks to your honest and constructive comments, we've made significant improvements from one event to the next. We're happy to report that our latest playtest received the best feedback we've ever had, with extremely low bug incidents. This success has given us the confidence to announce the full release of [i]I Come In Peace[/i] on Steam!

In the meantime, we're putting the final touches on the game and adding some new and exciting content. A new demo release is set to be available in the next few weeks, so make sure to follow us to be among the first to dive into this thrilling bullet-hell adventure.

If you're interested in our development process, you can watch our devlogs on the community hub's video section or visit our channel on YouTube. We love sharing behind-the-scenes insights and can't wait to hear your thoughts.

2025 is going to be so much fun!

[b]Stay tuned, and thank you for your continued support.
[/b]
— The FooYa Team
